The Traveler 12-inch Blue Ocean is a desk globe, made to sit on a desk or bookshelf rather than the floor. For what you're describing now—an illuminated political map with bright, bold country colours—I'd point you to the National Geographic Nicollet 16" Illuminated Desk Globe in Blue Ocean. It has that classic crisp, saturated blue-ocean political map by day, and when lit it reveals a second physical terrain map underneath, all on a 16-inch scale that reads beautifully on a desk or credenza.

You'll find it under that exact name in search, ready to add to your cart.
